Karaya Analysis · Marina Tower OM · 50 pp

Marina Tower pencils at 18.4% IRR on the model I built from the OM — with two material risks worth underwriting.

The OM offers a 47-storey mixed-use scheme on the Corniche plot (residential top, branded hospitality mid, retail+F&B podium). Cordoba have priced the opportunity at SAR 1.78bn, with stabilised NOI of SAR 142M in Year 5. I've rebuilt the cashflow from their assumptions — opex looks light against my comps, and hospitality demand is the dominant swing factor.

01Executive Summary

My model supports the mixed-use programme at a leaner hospitality split than the OM's own headline — 18% of GFA. I've held construction cost at SAR 5,950 / sqm, which lifts yield-on-cost ~40 bps versus the OM's SAR 6,200 figure.

  • Programme: 47 floors, GFA 88,400 sqm — 56% residential, 18% hospitality, 18% office, 8% retail/F&B
  • Total project cost: SAR 1.78bn (land SAR 320M, hard SAR 1.18bn, soft SAR 168M, financing SAR 112M)
  • Stabilised NOI (Y5): SAR 142M — driven by branded residence premium and corniche-facing retail
  • Recommended exit: Hold to Y7 then partial recapitalisation; full exit to REIT in Y10
  • Permitting timeline: 14 months baseline · 18 months downside (Corniche heritage overlay risk)

03Material Risks Flagged
High
Hospitality demand softening — the OM assumes 68% stabilised occupancy. The Doha branded-residence market is absorbing 1,800 keys over the next 36 months; Marina Tower's 240 keys land into a thinning pipeline. Modelled: −90 bps IRR sensitivity per 5pp occupancy drop.
High
Corniche heritage overlay risk — The plot sits inside the 2024 heritage zoning revision. Permit could require massing setbacks of up to 4 floors on the south façade. My rec: budget SAR 38M contingency + 4-month delay.
Med
Construction cost inflation — Local steel and concrete are running 8–11% above the Q3 2025 base in the OM, which leaves only a 5% escalation buffer. Stress test at +15% adds SAR 178M to hard costs, drops IRR to 16.1%.
Med
Exit cap drift — the OM holds exit cap at 6.5%. Marina-comparable trades over the last 6 months have closed at 6.7–7.0%. 50 bps drift on exit cap = −110 bps to project IRR.
Low
Senior debt sizing — Comfortable headroom at 62% LTV; sponsor banks have indicated capacity to 68%. No covenant pressure.
Recommended Next Step
Build the financial model from the OM — pre-filled with the deal's assumptions and flagged where my numbers diverge from the OM.
I'll create a new master workbook in this project: programme mix, sources & uses, opex build-up, cashflow, and a sensitivity tab covering the two high risks. Cells where my model diverges from the OM are highlighted so you can review side-by-side.
